model: Exactly the saved 4492-real-parameter width2/all-q physical local-Schur/balanced-CG decoder, full432/288 A1 images. No new heads, q truncation, ViT, quotient or initialization change. All parameters train jointly. Keep ORIGINAL full-H kernel, not unique-key backend. No N16 computation, new ED, remote jobs or production allocation.
streams: Disjoint PRNG fold-in tags health=1, train=2, audit_parent=3, audit_terminal=4. Each phase uses8 fresh uniform fixed-M=0 chains and8 deliberately ordered checkerboard/stripe chains, with independent keys between groups. Always refresh current amplitudes after a parameter update. Blocks are32 proposals per chain, not32 lattice sweeps.
health_policy: Fixed1024-proposal burn then32 monitored snapshots separated by32 proposals. Record log Born weights, 3<SzSz> NN estimator, cohort drift, descriptive classical split-Rhat/within-chain ESS and128 full-H centers. Nonfinite/zero post-burn amplitudes or a chain that never changes across monitoring block training. Rhat>1.2 or cohort disagreement warns, not automatic endless burn-in. A finite short trial may proceed as optimization feasibility with unresolved equilibrium; no physics win is certified by these short chains.
training: At most24 attempts,32 centers per attempt from16 persistent chains and2 snapshots. Existing Adam at3e-4, global real force per site, clip norm1, sampled FS cap0.03 with8 bisections using only training samples. No candidate H or energy-based checkpoint selection. Moments advance on every attempt. Terminal state is step24, not the best training energy. Save/reload checkpoint after every block/update: parameters, moments, chains, keys, phase counters, observations, history, H ledger and cumulative active wall time. No automatic continuation past budget.
audit: After training, independent fresh parent/terminal streams, each1024 burn proposals plus32 snapshots with energy every2:256 full-H centers per state. Audit never selects step, learning rate or checkpoint. Unpaired whole-chain mean SE and independent chain bootstrap stratified by start cohort. Report complex local-energy variance/N, not variance of Re(E). Rhat/ESS and start dependence limit all claims; a downward training curve alone is not a variational win.
caps: Separate serial CPU process per geometry; 1800s cumulative active wall alarm including compilation, health, training and audits;8GiB RSS checked between stages. Preserve checkpoint/failure on cap, no budget extension. No tile sweep. If terminal audit is incomplete, do not substitute training samples.
